integrity: Direct proof with separately identified finite corroborative checks; no infinite inference from experiments.
scientific_limitations: Canonical intrinsic Euclidean unit-edge metric only, not arbitrary weights or other graphs. Published graph-cut theorem already covers the radius; the claimed new results are complete center loci, affine dimension and endpoint tangent-facet counts. Bibliographic equivalence risk and no independent mathematical validation.
title: Complete Euclidean incenter loci of complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes
